sections.heading: What you get back
sections.body:
A transcript is the full text of the recording, in order. It is not a short summary of the main points. If you need the main points, copy the transcript and read it yourself, or paste it into a separate tool that summarizes text.

The transcript follows the speech, so the words are only as clear as the recording. Names, numbers and technical words are the parts most worth checking against the audio before you use the text. The transcript also does not say which person spoke each part, so for a meeting with several people, you will need to add names yourself.

If the file has no speech in it, the tool replies with No speech found. That tells you the recording is quiet or has no talking, so you know to check the file rather than try again.
